mission.title: cilium: CFP: ListenerSet for Cilium GatewayAPI Controller
mission.description: CFP: ListenerSet for Cilium GatewayAPI Controller. Requested by 44+ users.

steps.title: Check current cilium deployment
steps.description:
Verify your cilium version and configuration:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
helm list -n cilium 2>/dev/null || echo "Not installed via Helm"
```
This feature requires a working cilium installation.

steps.title: Review cilium configuration
steps.description:
Inspect the relevant cilium configuration:
```bash
kubectl get all -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
kubectl get configmap -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/part-of=cilium
```
Add support for the experimental Gateway API resource XListenerSet, introduced in Gateway API v1.3+ (and still part of the experimental channel as of v1.4).

steps.title: Apply the fix for CFP: ListenerSet for Cilium GatewayAPI Controller
steps.description:
An initial batch of container images have been built from the branch. If you have a bleeding edge Cilium installation, you can test `ListenerSet` features using the following container image for the `cilium-operator`.

**This is pre-alpha software and should not be used in a production
```yaml
quay.io/cilium/operator-generic-ci:d12045db0d6394f328b423dfa209590b4aad6d8e
```

steps.title: Verify the feature works
steps.description:
Test that the new capability is working as expected:
```bash
kubectl get pods -n cilium -l app.kubernetes.io/name=cilium
kubectl get events -n cilium --sort-by='.lastTimestamp' | tail -10
```
Confirm the feature described in "CFP: ListenerSet for Cilium GatewayAPI Controller" is functioning correctly.

resolution.summary: An initial batch of container images have been built from the branch. If you have a bleeding edge Cilium installation, you can test `ListenerSet` features using the following container image for the `cilium-operator`.
codeSnippets:
$ git checkout --track origin/pr/asauber/implement-listener-sets
$ make kind-down
$ make kind
$ WAIT_DURATION=5m make kind-servicemesh-install-cilium-fast
$ make gateway-api-conformance
$ # You now have a local cluster with ListenerSet support

prerequisites.description: A running Kubernetes cluster with cilium installed or the issue environment reproducible.
